summary:
I cannot say enough about the Hell Divers series. I have listen to 1 through 4 all in a row and I am anxiously waiting for #5 (and hopefully more after that).

First let's talk about R.C. Bray - this is the first book I have listened to and he is great! He's in my top 3 for sure (and I listen to a ton of books).

Second let's discuss the author - Nicholas Sansbury Smith. He really brings these characters to life to the point that you care about what happens next. So many book are shallow in that regard and his depth, while not bogging the story down, is incredible. I also reached out to him on Twitter with a question about the book and he got right back to me - that was cool and appreciated!

I already picked up the Extinction series to listen to as well!

Absolutely read this series - you won't regret it!
title: A Series That Truly Delivers
